scope: two frozen native B predictions, observation, masks, exact 4x4 block means; physical C before downstream geometry/alpha filtering

method.outside_rgb_mae: mean absolute RGB difference from original observation, normalized 0..1, including resizing/VAE reconstruction differences; not hidden-road accuracy
method.C_renderer_footprint: all 16 source pixels of each 4x4 block must satisfy C_native; geometry/retention/alpha/F filters only remove pixels
method.raw_and_composite_C_equivalence: all candidate C footprints have exactly zero target difference for both old-W and corrected-W composites

code_scope_review.direct_C: only photo_C/edge_C use target_C_srgb; edge loss requires both adjacent pixels inside the mask
code_scope_review.later_S: safe target-shadow interior intersects teacher_write=W_guard; all native footprint; excludes K, other-shadow and uncertain boundaries
code_scope_review.outside_preservation: uses baseline render RGB, not the full raw diffusion candidate

limits: This does not certify the correctness of generated hidden-road content.
Later S scope was reviewed in code; this numeric audit evaluates the physical C footprints.
This does not measure indirect changes outside the masks after shared 3D parameters are optimized.
No new rendering, GPU operation, inference, or training was performed.
